code_cause: case-port.ts:21 requires verifyScenarioOperations in every constructor.
Three W2 fixture constructors omit it: host-answer-reuse.test.ts:79, question-consumer.test.ts:44 and thread-actors-fixture.ts:127.
case-port.ts:27-62 drafts a real persisted case with alternatives, choices and preparedChanges empty; draft does not invoke the missing callback.
case-port.ts:86 invokes input.verifyScenarioOperations after source/access checks; line87 invokes it again for revalidation.
Calling the absent callback throws; case-port.ts:104-105 catches and returns unavailable:case-state-unavailable. The raw job exposes the returned reason, not the swallowed exception stack.
diagnostic.causal_status: Missing required callback and caught-exception mapping are source-proven. Identifying the swallowed TypeError as the run cause is a source inference consistent with all seven observed failure stages; no new instrumentation or test run was performed.
diagnostic.non_regression_reason: The required case-port code and all three missing-callback constructors are byte-identical at base, W2 and actual R3 checkout. These UI paths do not invoke sf-mcp-bridge or skill loader. Question/handoff shared dispatch does run but stops at case prerequisites; this is not an MCP execution proof.
diagnostic.other_failures: The six WP04 finance/sourcing failures are separate and are not explained or changed by this proposal.
diagnostic.base_rerun: NOT_RUN; no unchanged/local rerun, source/blob comparison only.

contract.implementation: Use the exact restricted callback already present in target d088708 thread-actors fixture for the two other empty-case Collaboration fixtures.
contract.allowed_case: A case with zero alternatives, zero choices and zero preparedChanges, with the existing host.revalidate(context) returning true.
contract.denied_case: Any nonempty alternatives, choices or preparedChanges; no scenario producer, operation grant or domain evidence is fabricated.
contract.remaining_checks: The unchanged case port still validates Request identity, abort status, participant scope, source evidence, case/incarnation/version, complete case digest, and final state snapshot. Callback never replaces those checks.

canonical_context.meaning: Production has a current-authority/digest/revalidation branch when no stored scenario operation is selected. The fixture boundary is stricter: it refuses all alternatives, choices and prepared changes, and does not claim to test this production scenario verifier.

contract.fixture_data: All affected tests draft real SQLite cases with real issued Dashboard sources. Their case mutations change objective/version/participants; they do not populate scenario arrays. Existing synthetic actor headers, fixed clocks, recipient leases and archives retain their existing declared fixture status.
contract.proof_class: UI component/fixture composition only; no Task/Relay/Schedule admission, provider run, native receipt or AM02 completion claim.

variants.meaning: Reproducible three-constructor repair for the exact failed R3/source base.
Preserve Reports48 fixture change already present on sf2-stack; add only the two missing callbacks.

target_reconciliation.reason: The full W2 thread-actors postimage equals the already-existing target blob, so target variant contains no diff for that file. Reports48 callback and all other target bytes are retained.
target_reconciliation.other_target_preimages: Answer/question files are byte-identical between W2 and d088708; their pre/postimages are shared by both variants. Do not apply the W2 patch to a target with divergent preimages.

dependencies: Coordinator/owner must re-fetch the current sf2-stack head and each target preimage through GitHub MCP before CAS publication; the observed target can advance.
Choose exactly one variant after matching preimage blobs. Do not copy an old thread-actors fixture over current Reports48.
Retain all existing assertions and race/revocation/source-access tests; do not replace evidence with unconditional acceptance, seed scenario grants or broaden production authority.
If a future test requires a nonempty scenario, compose its actual producer and canonical scenario authority separately; this intentionally narrow fixture callback must keep denying it.

owner_additional_cases: Confirm each proposed callback refuses a nonempty alternative, choice or prepared change and a revoked context; the callback is an empty-case scope restriction, never evidence of real scenario authority.
Preserve original question consumer forged-payload/cloned-context/C11/source-period/version/content-race/HTTP assertions; all must execute after the restored prerequisite.
Preserve handoff unchanged snapshots/no-domain-write and wrong-operation/revocation assertions.

validation.acceptance: Keep the seven R3 failures in the evidence ledger. Only a new pinned hosted run after owner adoption can report these cases passing; this artifact is not a proof of completion.
